refnamediv.refpurpose: Gets time of last page modification

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
intfalsegetlastmod
Gets the time of the last modification of the main script of execution.
The main script of execution is the request's entry script: the file that PHP was invoked with. It stays the same even when this function is called from a file reached through include, require, or an auto_prepend_file or auto_append_file that is currently executing.
If you're interested in getting the last modification time of a different file, consider using filemtime.
